description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is seeking an early-career Software Engineer to support its Space Software Product Line. The role contributes to the design, development, testing, and peer review of flight software for space vehicles and payloads within an Agile team.
Software engineer developing, testing, and reviewing code within Agile delivery teams

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate in the design of code implementations
• Develop and test software as part of a larger Agile execution team
• Contribute to peer code review and merge approval

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field
• Proficiency in C++ programming language
• Demonstrated experience with Linux Operating Systems
• Experience working in an Agile Environment
• Strong analytical/problem solving abilities
• Effective communication for cross-team coordination

Preferred:
• Knowledge/experience in a Version Control System (Git)
• Experience with one or more of the following: Python, JavaScript, HTML
• Experience using automated unit testing frameworks
• Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice
